body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> Samsung and LG is admittedly world class companies in display industry. And now both of them have presented their ‘PDP(Plasma Display Panel)’ and ‘LCD(Liquid Crystal Display)’ TVs in KES 2005, claiming each other that it is the first or the biggest model Samsung has introduced its 102-inch PDP TV as ‘the world-biggest TV’ together with 82-inch LCD TV, 80-inch PDP TV, 57-inch LCD TV. Particularly, Samsung seems to distinguish itself from other competitor (of course, LG) by emphasizing the term ‘common’ to describe models as ‘the biggest display in Korea among common product’. Meanwhile, LG also try to demonstrate itself to be the world-first company to develop 71-inch PDP TV. Who says the truth? Well…but who cares?
